result.instructions: Tools for Addigy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which Macs in our fleet have FileVault turned off?"; "Show the unattended alerts from the last day and acknowledge the ones about disk space."; "Which devices are assigned to the Standard Mac policy?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Addigy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run addigy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run addigy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run addigy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. addigy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: addigy_whoami
tools.title: Show the API key's organization
tools.description: Return the name of the calling API key and the organization_id that owns it. Use it first to confirm the connection. Addigy: GET /api/v2/configuration/whoami.

tools.name: addigy_get_permissions
tools.title: List the API key's permissions
tools.description: List the permissions granted to the calling API key. Check it before a tool call that fails with HTTP 403. Addigy: GET /api/v2/configuration/permissions.

tools.name: addigy_list_available_facts
tools.title: List device facts
tools.description: List the device facts available for filters and sorting, such as `device_model_name`, `filevault_enabled` or custom facts. Use the identifiers in addigy_search_devices. Addigy: GET /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/facts.

tools.name: addigy_search_devices
tools.title: Search devices
tools.description: Find devices by fact filters, policy or free text, and return their facts. Filters combine with AND. Example: filevault_enabled = false. Addigy: POST /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/devices.

audit_field.description: Device fact identifier to compare, for example `device_model_name` or `filevault_enabled`.

value.description: Value to compare with. Dates are RFC 3339 strings. Text `contains` accepts a list (any match counts).

policy_id.description: Return only devices assigned to this policy ID.

search_any.description: Free-text search over device fact values.

desired_fact_identifiers.description: Facts to return per device. Empty returns all.

tools.name: addigy_get_device_policies
tools.title: List a device's policies
tools.description: List the policies assigned to one device. Addigy: GET /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/devices/{agent_id}/policy-assignments.

agent_id.description: Addigy agent ID of the device (from addigy_search_devices).

tools.name: addigy_get_device_tickets
tools.title: List a device's tickets
tools.description: List the support tickets linked to one device. Addigy: GET /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/devices/{agent_id}/tickets.

agent_id.description: Addigy agent ID of the device (from addigy_search_devices).

tools.name: addigy_get_device_compliance
tools.title: Check devices against compliance
tools.description: Return whether each listed device passes its compliance benchmarks, with the result per benchmark. Addigy: POST /api/v2/oa/devices/compliance/status/query.

agent_ids.description: Addigy agent IDs of the devices to check (at least one).

tools.name: addigy_list_policies
tools.title: List policies
tools.description: List policies, including the policies of child organizations. Omit `policies` to get every policy. Addigy: POST /api/v2/oa/policies/query.

policies.description: Policy IDs to get. Omit to get every policy.

tools.name: addigy_list_alerts
tools.title: List received alerts
tools.description: List monitoring alerts by status. Use `Unattended` for alerts that need action. Addigy: GET /api/v2/monitoring/received-alerts.

tools.name: addigy_list_system_events
tools.title: List system events
tools.description: List system events (audit log) in a time range, with optional text searches. Pass `search_after` from the last result to get the next page. Addigy: POST /api/v2/events/query.

from_date_time.description: Start of the range, RFC 3339 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z). Omit to start at the oldest event.

to_date_time.description: End of the range, RFC 3339. Required: without it no events match.

queries.description: Text searches that every returned event must match.

sort_direction.description: `desc` for newest first (default), `asc` for oldest first.

search_after.description: Paging cursor: the search_after value from the previous result.

tools.name: addigy_list_scripts
tools.title: List saved scripts
tools.description: List the saved scripts in the organization's script library. Reading a script does not run it. Addigy: POST /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/scripts/query.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by, such as `name`, `version` or `created_date`.

sort_order.description: Sort direction (default asc when sort_field is set).

tools.name: addigy_list_benchmarks
tools.title: List compliance benchmarks
tools.description: List the compliance benchmarks the organization can see, including pre-built ones. Addigy: POST /api/v2/oa/benchmarks/query.

sort_field.description: Benchmark field to sort by, such as `name`.

tools.name: addigy_list_org_users
tools.title: List organization users
tools.description: List the Addigy console users of the organization: email, name and role. Addigy: POST /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/users/query.

sort_field.description: User field to sort by, such as `email`, `name` or `addigy_role`.

tools.name: addigy_get_ticket_notes
tools.title: List notes on a ticket
tools.description: List the notes on one ticket. Set `include_internal` to also return internal notes. Addigy: GET /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/tickets/{ticket_id}/notes.

tools.name: addigy_assign_devices_to_policies
tools.title: Assign devices to policies
tools.description: WRITE: add the listed devices to the listed policies. Re-running the same call does nothing new. Does not run commands on devices. Addigy: POST /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/devices/assign.

agent_ids.description: Addigy agent IDs of the devices.

policy_ids.description: Policy IDs to assign the devices to.

tools.name: addigy_unassign_devices_from_policies
tools.title: Remove devices from policies
tools.description: WRITE: remove the listed devices from the listed policies. This can stop the policy's settings and software on those devices. Addigy: POST /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/devices/unassign.

agent_ids.description: Addigy agent IDs of the devices.

policy_ids.description: Policy IDs to remove the devices from.

tools.name: addigy_update_alerts
tools.title: Acknowledge, mute or resolve alerts
tools.description: WRITE: change the state of received alerts. `mute` needs `days_to_mute`. Resolved alerts cannot change again. Addigy: POST /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/monitoring/alerts/{action}.

action.description: What to do with the alerts.

days_to_mute.description: Days to mute the alerts. Required for `mute`.

tools.name: addigy_add_ticket_note
tools.title: Add a note to a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to one ticket. Each call adds a new note; it is not idempotent. Addigy: POST /api/v2/o/{organization_id}/tickets/{ticket_id}/notes.

annotations.title: Add a note to a ticket

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Addigy
prompts.description: What you can do with Addigy here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_macs_that_fail_a_security_check
prompts.title: Find Macs that fail a security check
prompts.description: Find the devices with FileVault turned off, then check each one against its compliance benchmarks.

prompts.name: triage_unattended_alerts
prompts.title: Triage unattended alerts
prompts.description: List the alerts that need action. Then acknowledge, mute or resolve the ones you have checked.

prompts.name: review_the_policies_and_tickets_of_one_device
prompts.title: Review the policies and tickets of one device
prompts.description: Find a device, then list the policies assigned to it and its support tickets. Read the notes of a ticket.

prompts.name: move_devices_between_policies
prompts.title: Move devices between policies
prompts.description: List the policies, then assign devices to one policy or remove them from it. Removing can stop that policy's settings on those devices.

prompts.name: audit_console_activity
prompts.title: Audit console activity
prompts.description: Search the system events of a time range. List the console users with their roles to see who can make changes.
